explanation: The article on the Colombian civil war says its repercussions included "the eventual loss of the Department of Panama as an incorporated territory of the republic in 1903", and that the American navy was sent by Roosevelt's government to protect United States interests in the construction of the Panama Canal. The treaty article says the United States intent to influence the area "led to the separation of Panama from Colombia in 1903 and its establishment as an independent state", and the treaty of 18 November 1903 was signed by the United States and that new state. A treaty between Washington and Panama was possible only because Panama had ceased to be Colombian, which is what the war ended in.
